d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Senegal has plunged into a dramatic constitutional and financial crisis after its ruling party, PASTEF, formally expelled President Bassirou Diomaye Faye alongside 31 senior officials. The ouster marks the final collapse of the once-inseparable alliance between Faye and PASTEF leader Ousmane Sonko, who handpicked Faye to run for president in 2024 before being dismissed as prime minister in May 2026.
